issue.title: Measure series truncation in the quad- and octo-double chains, and reproduce the I19-win2 states

labels.name: win2
labels.description: Task for win2, the Windows desktop

issue.body:
**What.** Measure the horizon (and centre) series truncation of the quad- and octo-double chains (#215, I13-win, I19-win2) in their own precision. Also check that the I19-win2 crawl states (D 214.6–215.03, in delta_all.csv) reproduce a small |F| with the options they ran with (`--reseed 2 --od_junk 4`). Recommended in #254's summary (its task 5), plus its discrepancy 4.

**Why.** The double-double measure doesn't apply to those chains: their double-double horizon rows read 2e-9 at D 150 against 1e-31 in quad- and octo-double. And on the plain layout the I19-win2 crawl states give |F| 2.6e23 in all three precisions, which needs to be shown to come from the layout options, not the states.

**Acceptance (can fail).** A table of truncations per chain and D, in the chain's precision, with any above its tolerance listed with the Δ it fed. The I19-win2 states give |F| at their recorded level with their own options, or the discrepancy is reported.

**Depends on.** #254.

comments.body: Coordinator: the second part goes to win2 now (the first part, the truncation in quad- and octo-double, waits for code). On win2, in the worktree and venv that ran #19 (`..\choptuik-t126`, venv-t126), raw folder `I268-win2/`: for each state of `I19-win2/crawl/` that has a row in delta_all.csv (D 214.6, 214.7, 214.8, 214.9, 215.0, 215.025 and 215.03125), run the octo-double load check that `anm_run.py` makes of a start state, with the crawl`s own options (`--kfreeze 3 --corrector od --tol_od 1e-40 --qd_it 12 --od_junk 4 --jet_o 1 --reseed 2 --reseed_q 1`, as in I19-win2/README.md), taking that state as `--state` and no step beyond it. Record max|F| in octo-double and the junk-projected correction for each. For comparison, #254 read |F| = 2.6e23 for these states on the plain layout (no kfreeze 3) in all three precisions. **Acceptance (can fail):** each state gives the |F| and projected correction its crawl log recorded, to the digits printed, or the difference is reported.

**Started, win2, 2026-11-10 00:22:07 UTC, the second part of #268** (the octo-double load check of the I19-win2 crawl states; the first part, the truncation in quad- and octo-double, waits for code). Worktree `D:\choptuik-t126` (the project's move to D: took the old `..\choptuik-t126` with it; its `.git` file points to the old location, so git does not work there, but its `hp/*.py` are identical to e743608, which ran #19, and to c691ae3, which added `hp/data/delta_all.csv`), venv-t126 (Python 3.12.8, hpkernel 0.1.0, multidouble 0.1.0), Normal priority. For each of D 214.6, 214.7, 214.8, 214.9, 215.0, 215.025 and 215.03125, from `hp/`: `anm_run.py <raw> I268-win2/out_D<D> --state I19-win2/crawl/anm_pin3_D<D>.npz --kfreeze 3 --held_fit data/held_fit.json --N 24 --eps 1e-14 --h_max 0.1 --steps 0 --D_max 220 --threads 8 --corrector od --tol_od 1e-40 --qd_it 12 --od_junk 4 --jet_o 1 --reseed 2 --reseed_q 1 --save_pred 1`: the crawl's own options, `--steps 0` so that only the load check of the start state runs (the octo-double polish from its eight stored parts with `--reseed 2` inside ElimO), `--threads 8` instead of 18 beside #228 and #263. The seven states one after the other, expected 2 to 5 min each. `compare_268.py` will set the converged line (|F|, Delta and its correction) and the "octo-double Newton" line of each state against the crawl log's block of the same accepted step. #228 keeps priority for memory. Raw folder `I268-win2/`.

**Progress, 2026-11-10 00:35 UTC (13 min after the 00:22:07 start). First observation, interim: D 214.6 does not reproduce the recorded convergence so far.** The load check of `anm_pin3_D214.6000.npz` (the crawl's options, `--steps 0`) prints:

```
  od: 0 junk directions frozen (sigma 0e+00..0e+00), 4 weak ones with Delta content kept
  on 0: |F| 5.85e-36 -> 1.34e-19, |dz| 6.7e-24 -> 6.6e-24, lam 0.03125, dDelta +1.24e-24, piv 9.5e-16..2.0e+30, 182.94 s
  on 1: |F| 1.34e-19 -> 2.59e-19, |dz| 6.6e-24 -> 6.5e-24, lam 0.03125, dDelta +1.22e-24, piv 9.5e-16..2.0e+30, 177.86 s
```

The crawl log recorded for the accepted step into 214.6: `on 3: |F| 1.25e-26 -> 5.66e-48 ... on 4: |F| 5.66e-48 converged, Delta 1.69164734103273950 -9.3636e-17` and `octo-double Newton: 5 steps, max|F| 5.7e-48, converged`. Here the start |F| is 5.85e-36 (the converged-state level of the crawl is 5.7e-48) and a Newton step with a line-search factor of 0.03125 raises it to 1.3e-19; the iteration goes on (up to `--qd_it` 12, about 3 min per iteration at 8 threads beside #228 and #263, against 15 to 50 s in the crawl on 18 threads). Not a verdict: the first state has not finished, and the other six states have not run. The pivots in the log (9.5e-16 to 2.0e+30) are those of the crawl at the same D.

To save time the remaining states run in two more drivers (`run_i268_par.sh`, 4 threads each: 214.7 to 214.9 forward, 215.0312 to 215.0 backward) beside the first state's own process (8 threads); total machine use 16 of 20 threads for #268 plus #228 and #263, memory of the three runs about 0.3 GB. `compare_268.py` (selftest ok) sets each finished log against the crawl block of the same accepted step. Free memory 64.3 GB of 95.5 GB at 00:30.

**Progress, 2026-11-10 02:46 UTC (2 h 24 min after the 00:22:07 start). Interim table, 4 of the 7 states finished** (`compare_268.py` against `I19-win2/crawl.log`; the crawl recorded convergence for every one of them):

| D | recorded in the crawl log | load check here | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| 214.6 | 5 steps, last `|F|` 5.66e-48, Delta 1.69164734103273950, correction −9.3636e-17, converged | 12 steps, max`|F|` 7.8e-19, not converged (start `|F|` 5.85e-36, line-search factor 0.03125) | **not reproduced** |
| 214.7 | 4 steps, `|F|` 5.44e-60, Delta 1.69162536484306658, correction −1.0772e-16, converged | 3 steps, `|F|` 5.38e-56, Delta 1.69162536484306658, correction −1.0772e-16, converged | **converged; Delta and correction equal to the printed digits**; `|F|`, steps and the double-double `|F|` of the first two parts (6.1e+01 against 7.2e+01) differ |
| 214.8 | 5 steps, `|F|` 2.71e-67, Delta 1.69160340887732019, −3.6320e-17, converged | 12 steps, max`|F|` 4.6e-19, not converged | **not reproduced** |
| 214.9 | 4 steps, `|F|` 9.95e-60, Delta 1.69158147310758777, −1.0474e-16 | iteration 5 of 12 running, `|F|` 1.8e-18, line-search factor 0.0078 | pending |
| 215.0 | 4 steps, `|F|` 6.84e-59, Delta 1.69155955750600762, −2.8051e-17 | started 02:41 | pending |
| 215.025 | 3 steps, `|F|` 2.82e-45, Delta 1.69155408175362632, −6.4790e-17 | iteration 8 of 12 running, `|F|` 1.35e-18 | pending |
| 215.03125 | 3 steps, `|F|` 4.68e-46, Delta 1.69155271301216303, +4.6924e-18, converged | 12 steps, max`|F|` 1.5e-18, not converged | **not reproduced** |

So far one state of four reproduces the converged line; in the other three the loaded state starts at `|F|` 4 to 6e-36 and the first octo-double Newton steps, with line-search factors of 0.0078 to 0.0625, raise it to 1e-19 to 1e-18 and the iteration does not recover in 12 steps. The pivots in the logs equal the crawl's at the same D. Not an explanation yet: the state saved by the crawl is the projected point (`so.project`), whose plain residual is 5e-36 here, while the recorded 5e-48 to 2.7e-67 is the residual of the converged iterate inside the ElimO layout. I have not tested that reading (a check would load the state with `--reseed 0` or print the residual before and after the projection). The three remaining states finish by about 04:10 UTC (each iteration takes 6 to 7 min at 4 threads). Free memory 63.6 GB of 95.5 GB.

**Results of the second part, win2, 2026-11-10 04:20 UTC: one of the seven I19-win2 crawl states reproduces its recorded convergence under the load check, six do not.** All seven runs ended with exit 0 (`exits.txt`; 256 s for D 214.7, about 45 min for 214.6 and 4476 to 5276 s for the others, 4 to 8 threads, up to three at once beside #228). Worktree `D:\choptuik-t126` (hp code equal to e743608 and c691ae3), venv-t126 (Python 3.12.8), the crawl's own options with `--steps 0` (the octo-double polish of the start state from its eight stored parts, `--reseed 2` inside ElimO), `compare_268.py` against `I19-win2/crawl.log` (selftest ok).

| D | recorded in the crawl log (accepted step) | load check here | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| 214.6 | 5 steps, `|F|` 5.66e-48, Delta 1.69164734103273950, correction −9.3636e-17, converged | 12 steps, max`|F|` 7.8e-19, not converged | not reproduced |
| 214.7 | 4 steps, `|F|` 5.44e-60, Delta 1.69162536484306658, −1.0772e-16, converged | 3 steps, `|F|` 5.38e-56, **Delta 1.69162536484306658, −1.0772e-16**, converged | **Delta and correction equal to the printed digits**; `|F|` (5.4e-60 against 5.4e-56), steps (4 against 3) and the double-double `|F|` of the first two parts (61 against 72) differ |
| 214.8 | 5 steps, `|F|` 2.71e-67, Delta 1.69160340887732019, −3.6320e-17 | 12 steps, max`|F|` 4.6e-19, not converged | not reproduced |
| 214.9 | 4 steps, `|F|` 9.95e-60, Delta 1.69158147310758777, −1.0474e-16 | 12 steps, max`|F|` 1.9e-18, not converged | not reproduced |
| 215.0 | 4 steps, `|F|` 6.84e-59, Delta 1.69155955750600762, −2.8051e-17 | 12 steps, max`|F|` 3.4e-19, not converged | not reproduced |
| 215.025 | 3 steps, `|F|` 2.82e-45, Delta 1.69155408175362632, −6.4790e-17 | 12 steps, max`|F|` 1.3e-18, not converged | not reproduced |
| 215.03125 | 3 steps, `|F|` 4.68e-46, Delta 1.69155271301216303, +4.6924e-18 | 12 steps, max`|F|` 1.5e-18, not converged | not reproduced |

In the six that do not converge the loaded state starts at `|F|` 4 to 6e-36 (the recorded final values are 1e-45 to 1e-67), the first Newton steps are accepted only with line-search factors of 0.0625 to 0.0039, `|F|` rises to 1e-19 to 1e-18 and then creeps up by about 1e-20 to 2e-20 per step, with `|dz|` 6e-24 to 1.5e-23; the pivots are close to the crawl's at the same D (9.5e-16 to 2.0e+30 here at 214.6, 9.6e-16 to 2.0e+30 in the crawl). The double-double `|F|` of the first two parts is 45 to 73 in all seven, as in the crawl log (50 to 61), so that number does not tell the states apart. The octo-double residual of each stored state is small (4 to 6e-36), but the Newton iteration does not converge from it in six of seven.

**An observation, not an explanation.** ElimO's counters at the end of the runs: in the six failing load checks `{'u0q': 0, 'skipped': 79 to 103}` (no point was projected, all were below the re-seed threshold), in the converging one (214.7) `{'u0q': 1, 'skipped': 2}`; in the crawl log's accepted steps `u0q` is 1 or 2 in all seven (`failed` 0, 1 or 5 and `skipped` 2 or 3). So the crawl's convergence went with a projection (re-seed at u0 in quad-double) that a start already at `|F|` 5e-36 does not trigger. I have not tested that this is the cause.

**An extra check, running** (not asked): the same load check on the crawl's saved **predictions**, `I19-win2/crawl/pred_pin3_D<D>.npz` (`--save_pred 1`), which are the starts the crawl's corrector had at each accepted step; D 214.6, 214.8 and 215.03125 started at 04:06:46 UTC (5 threads each, `run_i268_pred.sh`, logs `load_pred_D*.log`). If the crawl's convergence reproduces from them, the saved converged states are not valid starting points for the load check, not that the crawl's results are in doubt. Results follow in this issue.

**Discrepancy reported, nothing fixed:** the issue's second part expected the states to give a small `|F|` with their own options; six of seven do not converge under the load check and one does. Whether the crawl's Delta values (`delta_all.csv`) are affected is not decided by this check: for the seven accepted steps the Delta and its correction are recorded in the crawl log, and the load check reproduces them only at 214.7.

**Raw:** `I268-win2/` at the commit of this push (seven `load_D*.log`, `exits.txt`, `compare_268.py` and `compare_268.log`, `run_i268*.sh`, README). The first part of #268 (truncation in the quad- and octo-double chains) waits for code and is not started; the issue stays open.

**Extra check on the crawl's saved predictions, win2, 2026-11-10 05:15 UTC: one of three reproduces the recorded convergence.** The same load check (the crawl's options, `--steps 0`, 5 threads, `--state I19-win2/crawl/pred_pin3_D<D>.npz`, the start the crawl's own corrector had at each accepted step; `run_i268_pred.sh`, logs `load_pred_D*.log`, 800 s to 3754 s each):

| D | recorded in the crawl log | load check on the saved prediction | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| 214.6 | 5 steps, `|F|` 5.66e-48, Delta 1.69164734103273950, correction −9.3636e-17, converged | 6 steps, `|F|` 6.26e-49, **Delta 1.69164734103273950, correction −9.3636e-17**, converged | **reproduced, Delta and correction equal to the printed digits** (6 steps against 5, `|F|` 6.3e-49 against 5.7e-48) |
| 214.8 | 5 steps, `|F|` 2.71e-67, Delta 1.69160340887732019, −3.6320e-17 | 12 steps, max`|F|` 2.2e-22, not converged | not reproduced |
| 215.03125 | 3 steps, `|F|` 4.68e-46, Delta 1.69155271301216303, +4.6924e-18 | 12 steps, max`|F|` 1.3e-21, not converged | not reproduced |

At 214.6 the first iteration starts exactly as the crawl's (`|F|` 7.41e-21, `|dz|` 4.5e-15, dDelta −4.50e-15, pivots 9.6e-16 to 2.0e+30) but with a line-search factor of 0.125 where the crawl's was 0.5, then converges. ElimO's counters at the end: 214.6 `{'u0q': 3, 'failed': 4, 'skipped': 3}` (the crawl: `u0q` 2, `failed` 1), 214.8 `{'u0q': 12, 'failed': 20}` (the crawl: 2 and 5), 215.03125 `{'u0q': 12, 'failed': 33}` (the crawl: 1 and 0): the failing runs project at every iteration and still do not converge.

**Together with the first table:** from the saved converged states 1 of 7 reproduces (214.7), from the saved predictions 1 of 3 (214.6), and the Delta and correction are the crawl's to the printed digits whenever a run converges. So the crawl's recorded Deltas were not contradicted by any run that converged, but the octo-double Newton's convergence is not reproduced from the saved files by this load check in 6 of 7 and 2 of 3 cases. A candidate cause that I can test cheaply is the thread count (the crawl ran 18 threads, these 4 to 8; a reduction order that depends on it would change the trial residuals near 1e-20): D 214.8's prediction is rerunning now at `--threads 18` (`run_i268_pred18.sh`, started 05:10:29, 10 to 25 min). Other candidates, untested: the Reseeder's history before the corrector (the crawl's attempts start with a failed re-seed, `a 0.1000: re-seeded (FAILED, prediction kept)`), and the firmware (the crawl ran on the old firmware, microcode 0x110; these runs on 0x122).

**Summary of the second part of #268, win2, 2026-11-10 05:35 UTC. The thread count does not decide the convergence; the second part is complete and `running` is removed, the issue stays open for the first part.**

**Thread-count test.** The D 214.8 prediction, which does not converge at 5 threads, rerun with the crawl's own 18 threads (`run_i268_pred18.sh`, 951 s, exit 0): the iteration lines are identical to the 5-thread run (|F|, |dz|, line-search factor, dDelta and the ElimO counters `u0q` 12, `failed` 20; only the times differ), ending at max`|F|` 2.2e-22, not converged. So a thread-dependent reduction order is not the cause.

**What ran** (all exit 0): seven load checks on the saved converged states (the crawl's options, `--steps 0`, 4 to 8 threads), three on the saved predictions (5 threads) and one at 18 threads; worktree `D:\choptuik-t126` (hp code equal to e743608 and c691ae3), venv-t126 (Python 3.12.8), Normal priority, BIOS 3.40 (the crawl ran on the old firmware, microcode 0x110).

**Result against the acceptance** ("each state gives the |F| and projected correction its crawl log recorded, to the digits printed, or the difference is reported"):

| start | states that converge as recorded | states that do not |
|---|---|---|
| saved converged states (7) | D 214.7: Delta 1.69162536484306658 and correction −1.0772e-16 equal to the printed digits (`|F|` 5.4e-56 in 3 steps against 5.4e-60 in 4) | 214.6, 214.8, 214.9, 215.0, 215.025, 215.03125: 12 iterations, max`|F|` 3.4e-19 to 1.9e-18, not converged |
| saved predictions (3 of the 7) | D 214.6: Delta 1.69164734103273950 and correction −9.3636e-17 equal to the printed digits (`|F|` 6.3e-49 in 6 steps against 5.7e-48 in 5) | 214.8 (max`|F|` 2.2e-22), 215.03125 (1.3e-21) |

Whenever a run converges, its Delta and junk-projected correction are the crawl's to the printed digits (2 of 2), and they equal the `delta_all.csv` rows (`hp/data/delta_all.csv`, `Delta_q0`, `Delta_q1`): D 214.6 1.6916473410327395 and −9.363597e-17, D 214.7 1.6916253648430666 and −1.07719e-16; no run that converged contradicts `delta_all.csv`. The other eight of ten runs do not converge, so the discrepancy is reported as asked: the octo-double Newton's convergence is not reproduced from the saved files by this load check, not the crawl's Deltas.

**Not shown, candidates for the cause:** (a) the crawl's attempts begin with a failed re-seed (`a 0.1000: re-seeded (FAILED, prediction kept)`) and ElimO's counters differ between the crawl's accepted steps (`u0q` 1 to 2, `failed` 0 to 5) and the load checks (`u0q` 0 for the six failing state loads; 12 for the failing prediction loads, with `failed` 20 and 33); the Reseeder's history before the corrector is not reproduced by a load check. (b) The firmware (microcode 0x122 now, 0x110 then); it should not change IEEE floating-point results, and the converging load checks reproduce the crawl's Delta digits, which argues against a wrong computation, but I did not test it further. (c) The saved files themselves.

**Recommended tasks** (not opened by me):

1. **Reproduce the crawl's first step on the new firmware.** What: from `hp/` of `D:\choptuik-t126`, the I19-win2 command with `--steps 1` from `T138-win2/chain_o/anm_pin3_D214.5000.npz` (`--kfreeze 3 --held_fit data/held_fit.json --N 24 --eps 1e-14 --h_max 0.1 --corrector od --tol_od 1e-40 --qd_it 12 --od_junk 4 --jet_o 1 --reseed 2 --reseed_q 1 --save_pred 1`, 14 to 18 threads), about 45 to 90 min including the base polish. Why: it runs the whole step the crawl ran (series, failed re-seed, corrector) and shows whether the crawl's first accepted step (D 214.6, 5 steps, `|F|` 5.7e-48, Delta 1.69164734103273950) is reproduced on this machine, which separates the load check's non-reproduction from the crawl's. Acceptance (can fail): the step is accepted at D 214.6 with Delta and correction equal to the crawl's to the printed digits, or the first differing line of its log against `I19-win2/crawl.log` is named. Depends on #268 (second part).
2. **Part 1 of #268 (truncation in the quad- and octo-double chains)** waits for code, as the coordinator wrote.

**Raw:** `I268-win2/` at the commit after this comment (seven `load_D*.log`, three `load_pred_D*.log`, `load_pred18_D214.8000.log`, `exits.txt`, `compare_268.py` and `compare_268.log`, the run scripts, README with the results).
